normalUpdatePath.entryStart: DemoMessageHandler reads indexDelta, accumulates entityIndex, then reads a two-bit command.
normalUpdatePath.comparisonStart: afterCommandReadCount is recorded immediately after bitBuffer.readBitsAsUInt(2).
normalUpdatePath.extractorEntry: For normal UPDATE with an existing entity, EntityMutationExtractor.applyTo(entity) or all() consumes entityData after afterCommand.
normalUpdatePath.fieldPathConsumption: EntityMutationExtractor calls FieldPathExtractor.allIds() or all(), which consumes field-path huffman operations until FINISH or unread end.
normalUpdatePath.fieldValueConsumption: For each field path, EntityMutationExtractor obtains a serializer decoder and calls it with the same BitBuffer.
normalUpdatePath.comparisonEnd: afterActionReadCount is recorded after extraction, skip, missing-fail handling, or command-specific action completion.

includes: any extractor-level reads needed to reach FINISH
command-action reads for CREATE paths when measured there
excludes: serializedEntities iterator bytes because those are read from a separate buffer

diagnosticImplication: actionDelta is a real local cursor-span metric, but static code review alone does not prove it is always the same metric as payloadBits.
